differences_from_full_prior_art: Uses 648 official EA Q1-2024 surface-water samples rather than the repository's full multi-agency EA/NRW/SEPA corpus.
Uses sample-matched pH, water temperature and conductivity only; weather, CORINE and MODIS features are unavailable in this bounded panel.
500 CFU/100 ml is a recreational-water convention, not a drinking-water standard.
claim_boundary: Demonstrates the prior-art XGBoost method on authentic EA observations; it is not bit-for-bit reproduction, direct sensor detection or Delhi-NCR drinking-network validation.
